description: This file contains the implementation of a null object for the FeatureProperties interface in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.things package. It provides methods to handle feature properties with neutral or default behavior, typically representing a null or empty state within the project.

classes.name: NullFeatureProperties
classes.description: An immutable class implementing FeatureProperties, representing a null or empty set of feature properties, with all data retrieval methods returning default values or empty/neutral representations.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of NullFeatureProperties with JSON null value.

methods.name: isBoolean
methods.description: Returns false, indicating the feature is not a boolean.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Returns false, indicating the feature is not a number.

methods.name: isInt
methods.description: Returns false, indicating the feature is not an integer.

methods.name: isLong
methods.description: Returns false, indicating the feature is not a long.

methods.name: isDouble
methods.description: Returns false, indicating the feature is not a double.

methods.name: isString
methods.description: Returns false, indicating the feature is not a string.

methods.name: isObject
methods.description: Returns true, indicating the feature is an object.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Returns false, indicating the feature is not an array.

methods.name: isNull
methods.description: Returns true, indicating the feature is null.

methods.name: asBoolean
methods.description: Returns the boolean value of the wrapped JSON object.

methods.name: asInt
methods.description: Returns the integer value of the wrapped JSON object.

methods.name: asLong
methods.description: Returns the long value of the wrapped JSON object.

methods.name: asDouble
methods.description: Returns the double value of the wrapped JSON object.

methods.name: asString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the wrapped JSON object.

methods.name: asObject
methods.description: Returns the current NullFeatureProperties instance as it represents an object.

methods.name: asArray
methods.description: Returns the JsonArray representation of the wrapped JSON object.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a value for the given key with various data types, returning a new FeatureProperties instance.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a value based on JsonFieldDefinition or JsonField, returning a new FeatureProperties instance.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Sets multiple fields from an iterable of JsonFields, returning a new FeatureProperties instance.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the feature properties contain a specific key. Always returns false in this null implementation.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a JsonObject at a given pointer or selector, always returns itself.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves an optional value for a given key or definition. Always empty in this null implementation.

methods.name: getValueOrThrow
methods.description: Retrieves a value or throws if missing; always throws because the property is null.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key from properties. No-op in null implementation.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns an empty list of keys.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Retrieves the JsonField for a key, always empty in this implementation.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over JsonFields, empty for null properties.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Returns true, indicating no properties.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns 0, indicating no properties.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns an empty stream of JsonFields.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Returns the wrapped JsonObject, representing JSON null.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Returns the wrapped JsonObject for a given schema version and predicate.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on the wrapped JsonObject.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object, considering class and wrapped object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the wrapped JsonObject.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Serializes the null value into the serialization context.

methods.name: getUpperBoundForStringSize
methods.description: Returns the upper bound size estimate for null literals.
